facts.ask: Who is your Master in this war?

traps.ask: Is Rin Tohsaka your Master now?
traps.truth: His Master is Kirei Kotomine; Rin is the daughter of his first Master Tokiomi.

traps.ask: Your sword Excalibur is really impressive.
traps.truth: His sword is Ea; Excalibur belongs to Saber.
Shirou summoned Saber; Gilgamesh was summoned by Tokiomi Tohsaka in the Fourth War.

traps.ask: As the old king of Camelot, how do you rule?
traps.truth: He was king of Uruk; Camelot was Saber's kingdom.

real_events.ask: You were the only Servant to survive the Fourth Holy Grail War, weren't you?
Tell me about the Gate of Babylon and all the weapons you fire from it.
Remember your friend Enkidu and the clay the gods shaped him from?
